reproduction_assumptions: This transient-ROM profile-guided communication extension is non-formal and not paper-equivalent.
The steady and transient profiles share the same nonthermal optimization controls; the transient ROM replaces only the thermal frequency evaluator.
Per-core weights are derived from completed canonical R1 shared-L2 demandAccesses requestor counters; canonical R1 is not rerun.
The weighted mean is used consistently in the optimizer and R2, but gem5 receives one scalar shared-L2XBar latency rather than independent per-core latencies.
Lambda_wire=0.0020119160767721133 is an FFT-local candidate rejected for formal or shared promotion.
Integer-cycle partition search uses the same nearest-rounding function as gem5 R2 and includes fixed-bin explicitly.
The ROM optimizer calls no HotSpot; eight training and two holdout HotSpot jobs calibrate and gate the model.
Final paired BIPS2_trans requires real-HotSpot periodic validation and current-layout gem5 R2 for both fixed-bin and CLIP-3D.
